summary: Feed s087_single is degraded: 20.7% GRE-tunneled traffic (356/1719 frames) is forwarded without decapsulation, hiding inner flows from APM. All other checks (duplicates, drops, truncation, one-way, VLAN, encryption, oversize, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding GRE-encapsulated traffic as-is without stripping the outer GRE header. 20.7% exceeds 10% threshold, indicating tunnel decapsulation is not enabled on this APM feed.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM cannot parse inner L3-L7 headers and transactions inside GRE; application response time, transaction tracing and dependency mapping will be incomplete or missed for ~1 in 5 flows.

recommended_fix.why: Stripping GRE at the packet broker exposes inner IPv4/IPv6 and TCP payload to the APM so it can correctly classify applications and measure performance without needing tunnel-aware parsing.
